# **Functional Specifications Requirement**
## **Objective**
| **#** | **Requirement** | **Notes** |
| **1** | Provide an overview dashboard showing **class‑level learning performance** | Focus on ILT/vILT class completion and attendance |
| **2** | Display **Class Completion Rate** based on learners completing required learning sessions | Certification is granted when class learning is completed |
| **3** | Display **Attendance Rate** reflecting learners’ participation across all required sessions | Core KPI for ILT/vILT classes |
| **4** | Clearly distinguish **class‑level completion metrics** from **learner‑level completion metrics** | Learner‑level metric is named “Learner Completion (%)” |
| **5** | Provide **Assessment Status Overview** to show exam participation and outcomes | Assessment does not affect class completion or certification |
| **6** | Allow admins to **filter assessment analytics by specific exam** within the class | Prevent empty or misleading charts |
| **7** | Visualize **Assessment Performance** using score distribution charts | Used for analytical and instructional insight only |
| **8** | Display **Assessment trend over time** based on selected assessment filter | Supports monitoring learner engagement with exams |
| **9** | Identify and surface **At‑Risk Learners** based on attendance, completion, or assessment signals | Risk is informative, not a certification blocker |
| **10** | Provide a **Learner Detail Table** summarizing completion, attendance, assessment status, and score | Supports sorting, scanning, and drill‑down |
| **11** | Enable navigation from **Learner Name** to learner‑specific assessment details within the class | Context remains at class level |
| **12** | Support **exportable reports (CSV, PDF)** reflecting current dashboard filters | Used for audit, review, and offline analysis |
## **Overview Business Workflow & Processes**
### **Overview and Scope of work**
| **#** | **Scope Of Work** | **Detail Task Description** |

| **1** | Class Performance Overview Dashboard | Provide an overview section showing **class‑level learning performance metrics**, including completion rate, attendance rate, assessment status, and at‑risk indicators for the class. |

| **2** | Class Completion Rate Calculation & Display | Calculate and display **Class Completion Rate** based on learners who complete all required learning sessions within the class. Certification eligibility is derived solely from learning completion, not assessment results. |

| **3** | Attendance Rate Calculation & Visualization | Calculate overall **Attendance Rate** for the class across all required ILT/vILT sessions and visualize attendance trends over time to support monitoring learner participation. |

| **4** | Clear Distinction Between Class‑Level and Learner‑Level Metrics | Ensure clear differentiation between **Class Completion Rate** (overview KPI) and **Learner Completion (%)** displayed in the learner detail table to avoid metric confusion. |

| **5** | Assessment Status Overview | Display assessment participation status (Passed, Incomplete, Not Attempted) for learners in the class for reporting and analytical purposes only, without impacting class completion or certification. |

| **6** | Assessment Filtering by Exam | Provide a dedicated **assessment filter** allowing administrators to view performance data for a selected exam or all exams in the class, preventing empty or misleading charts when an exam has no data. |

| **7** | Assessment Performance Analytics | Visualize assessment performance using score distribution charts based on selected assessment filters to evaluate learner exam performance and training effectiveness. |
| **8** | Assessment Activity Trend Analysis | Display assessment activity or performance trends over time (e.g. number of submissions, average scores) based on the selected assessment filter. |

| **9** | At‑Risk Learner Identification | Identify and display **At‑Risk Learners** based on attendance, learner completion progress, or assessment participation signals to support early intervention by instructors or admins. |

| 10 | Learner Detail Table | Provide a detailed learner table summarizing learner completion (%), attendance (%), assessment score, and assessment status to support class‑level monitoring and comparison. |

| **11** | Learner Assessment Drill‑down Navigation | Enable navigation from **Learner Name** to a learner‑specific assessment detail page within the same class context, showing assessment attempts, scores, and statuses. |

| 12 | Report Export Functionality | Support exporting Progress & Reports data to **CSV and PDF formats**, reflecting current dashboard filters and selections for audit, review, and offline analysis purposes. |

## **Functional Specification Detail**
### User story
| **As** | **As an Admin** |
| **I want to** | view class‑level progress, attendance, and assessment reports in a centralized **Progress & Reports** section |

| **So that** | I can monitor learner completion and attendance for certification purposes, analyze assessment outcomes, identify at‑risk learners early, and export reports for tracking, intervention, and audit needs |
### Prototype
| Class Basic information |  |  |

| ![](https://insight.fsoft.com.vn/conf/download/attachments/embedded-page/ISUITE2026/%5BUS-AD-095%5D%5BILT%20&%20vILT%5D%20%5BClass%20Mgnt%5D%20Class%20Details%20-%20Progress%20&%20Reports/image-2026-4-17_13-59-43.png?api=v2) |  |  |
Component description
| No | VN component | EN component | Component type | Editable | Mandatory | Description | Data mapping (suggestion) |

| **1** | Tiêu đề bảng điều khiển | Dashboard Title | Display text | No | Yes | Displays page title **“Progress & Reports”** to indicate reporting and analytics view for the class. Static text, aligned with Class Details navigation. | — |

| **2** | Bộ lọc bài thi ![](https://insight.fsoft.com.vn/conf/download/attachments/embedded-page/ISUITE2026/%5BUS-AD-095%5D%5BILT%20&%20vILT%5D%20%5BClass%20Mgnt%5D%20Class%20Details%20-%20Progress%20&%20Reports/image-2026-4-17_14-0-34.png?api=v2) | Assessment Filter | Dropdown | Yes | Conditional | Allows administrators and instructors to filter assessment‑related analytics by **specific exam** or view aggregated data across **All Exams** (default). **Business rules:** – The filter applies consistently to **Assessment Status, Assessment Performance, and Assessment Over Time charts**. – **Only published and assigned assessments** are displayed in the filter list. – When value changes → reload assessment dataset. **Edge cases:** – Class has no exam → show filter Empty State. – Selected exam has no submission → trigger Empty State. | [class.assessments.id](http://class.assessments.id) |

| **3** | Thông báo rỗng đánh giá | Assessment Empty State | Empty state message | No | Conditional | Displayed when the selected assessment has **no submission data available**. **Behavior:** – Related charts (status, distribution, over time) are hidden. – System displays a clear message (e.g. “No assessment data available for the selected exam”). – No placeholder or zero‑value charts are rendered to avoid misinterpretation. | assessment.submissions |

| **4** | Phân bố điểm | Assessment Performance | Bar chart | No | Conditional | Displays score distribution for the selected assessment using predefined score buckets. **Formula / Logic:** – Group learner scores into predefined buckets (e.g. 0–5, 5–10, >10). – Bucket config follows assessment max score & grading setup. **Data source:** assessment submissions + scores. ![](https://insight.fsoft.com.vn/conf/download/attachments/embedded-page/ISUITE2026/%5BUS-AD-095%5D%5BILT%20&%20vILT%5D%20%5BClass%20Mgnt%5D%20Class%20Details%20-%20Progress%20&%20Reports/image-2026-4-17_14-2-44.png?api=v2) **Business rules:** – Chart is rendered only when at least one valid score exists. – Buckets and score range follow assessment configuration. – Used to analyze assessment difficulty and learner performance trends, **not for certification decisions**. Data is refreshed dynamically when assessment filter changes. | assessment.scores |

| **5** | Xu hướng đánh giá | Assessment Over Time | Line chart | No | Conditional | Visualizes assessment activity trends over time based on the selected assessment filter. ![](https://insight.fsoft.com.vn/conf/download/attachments/embedded-page/ISUITE2026/%5BUS-AD-095%5D%5BILT%20&%20vILT%5D%20%5BClass%20Mgnt%5D%20Class%20Details%20-%20Progress%20&%20Reports/image-2026-4-17_14-3-48.png?api=v2) **Supported metrics (configured at class/system level):** – Number of submissions per day **Formula:** count(submissions grouped by submission\_date). Once configured, the metric is consistent across the class to ensure data interpretation clarity. | assessment.submissions.created\_at |

| **6** | Trạng thái đánh giá | Assessment Status | Donut / Pie chart | No | Conditional | Visualizes assessment participation status of learners within the class, categorized as **Passed, Incomplete, and Not Attempted**. ![](https://insight.fsoft.com.vn/conf/download/attachments/embedded-page/ISUITE2026/%5BUS-AD-095%5D%5BILT%20&%20vILT%5D%20%5BClass%20Mgnt%5D%20Class%20Details%20-%20Progress%20&%20Reports/image-2026-4-17_14-4-38.png?api=v2) **Business rules:** – Assessment status is **informational and analytic only**. – Assessment results do **not impact class completion or certification**. – Status is derived from submission and grading data: • Passed: submitted and score ≥ passing score • Incomplete: submitted but score < passing score • Not Attempted: no submission record This component is displayed only when at least one assessment is available in the class. | assessment.submissions.status |

| **7** | Completion Rate (của học viên) | **Learner Completion Rate** | KPI Card | No | Yes | Displays the percentage of learners who have completed the class based **solely on learning session completion (ILT/vILT attendance)**. ![](https://insight.fsoft.com.vn/conf/download/attachments/embedded-page/ISUITE2026/%5BUS-AD-095%5D%5BILT%20&%20vILT%5D%20%5BClass%20Mgnt%5D%20Class%20Details%20-%20Progress%20&%20Reports/image-2026-4-17_14-5-1.png?api=v2) **Business rules:** – A learner is considered “completed” when they meet the required attendance threshold or attend all mandatory sessions, depending on class configuration. – Assessment (exam) results **do not affect class completion or certification eligibility**. **Formula:** Completion Rate = (Number of completed learners / Total enrolled learners) × 100 **Rules:** – Completion determined by attendance threshold or mandatory sessions (class config). – Exam results are excluded. – total\_enrolled = 0 → value = 0%. | class.learners.completed\_count, class.learners.total |

| **8** | Attendance Rate | Attendance Rate | KPI Card | No | Yes | Displays the overall attendance rate across all required ILT/vILT sessions for the class. ![](https://insight.fsoft.com.vn/conf/download/attachments/embedded-page/ISUITE2026/%5BUS-AD-095%5D%5BILT%20&%20vILT%5D%20%5BClass%20Mgnt%5D%20Class%20Details%20-%20Progress%20&%20Reports/image-2026-4-17_14-5-23.png?api=v2) **Formula:** attended\_sessions / (total\_sessions × total\_learners) × 100. **Rules:** – Cancelled sessions excluded. – vILT attendance valid only if participation ≥ configured duration (default 80%). – Auto‑recalculated on attendance or session changes. | attendance.records |

| **9** | Nút xuất báo cáo | Export Reports | Button group | No | Conditional | Provides options to export dashboard data as **CSV** or **PDF**. Export reflects current filters (assessment filter, date range if applicable). Available only to authorized roles. | aggregated report data |

| 10 | Bảng chi tiết học viên | Learner Detail Table | Data table | No | Yes | Displays learner‑level summary metrics within the class, including **Learner Completion (%), Attendance (%), Score, and Assessment Status**. ![](https://insight.fsoft.com.vn/conf/download/attachments/embedded-page/ISUITE2026/%5BUS-AD-095%5D%5BILT%20&%20vILT%5D%20%5BClass%20Mgnt%5D%20Class%20Details%20-%20Progress%20&%20Reports/image-2026-4-17_14-5-56.png?api=v2) **Behavior:** – Data always reflects current Assessment Filter. – Supports pagination & sorting. – No edit capability. | learner.metrics |

| 11 | Tên học viên | Learner Name | Link | No | Yes | Each learner name is **clickable** and redirects to the **Learner Assessment Detail page** within the same class context. **Drill‑down behavior:** – System validates user permission (Admin / Instructor). – Opens a learner‑specific assessment view scoped strictly to the current class. – Displays exam list, attempt history, scores, and assessment status. – Navigation back to Progress & Reports preserves class context and filter state. Redirect does not navigate to global learner profile to prevent data scope leakage. | [learner.id](http://learner.id) |

| **12** | Hoàn thành của học viên | Learner Progress (%) | Number | No | Yes | Displays the individual learner’s completion percentage based on learning items or sessions completed within the class. **Business rules:** – Calculation logic is consistent with class‑level learning structure. – Tooltip explains formula and clarifies that this metric differs from class completion rate. | learner.progress |

| **13** | Điểm danh của học viên | Learner Attendance (%) | Number | No | Yes | Displays attendance percentage per learner across all required sessions. Value is used as one of the signals for at‑risk detection. | learner.attendance |

| **14** | Điểm bài thi | Score | Display text | No | Conditional | Displays learner’s score for the selected assessment with X (learner's actual score) / Y (Maximum score). Hidden or shown as “—” if learner has not attempted the exam. | assessment.score |

| **15** | Trạng thái bài thi | Assessment Status (learner) | Status text | No | Conditional | Displays learner’s assessment status for the selected exam as Completed, Incomplete, or Not Attempted. Status is derived strictly from submission and grading data and is **independent of learning completion status**. | assessment.submission.status |
Acceptance criteria
| AC# | Given | When | Then | Messages |
| **AC1** | Admin/Instructor is on the Class Details screen | The screen loads | The system displays the **Progress & Reports** tab | — |
| **AC2** | Admin/Instructor is on Class Details | The user clicks **Progress & Reports** tab | The Progress & Reports dashboard is displayed | — |
| **AC3** | The class has at least one **published and assigned assessment** | Progress & Reports loads | The system displays the **Assessment Filter** with default value **All Exams** | — |
| **AC4** | The class has **no published assessment** | Progress & Reports loads | Assessment Filter and all assessment‑related components are hidden | — |
| **AC5** | Assessment Filter is set to **All Exams** | Assessment section renders | Assessment Status, Performance, and Over Time charts show **aggregated data** | — |
| **AC6** | Admin selects a specific exam from Assessment Filter | The filter value changes | Assessment Status, Performance, and Over Time charts are reloaded based on the selected exam | — |

| **AC7** | The selected exam exists but has **no submissions** | Assessment charts attempt to render | All assessment charts are hidden and an empty state message is displayed | “No assessment data available for the selected exam.” |
| **AC8** | The selected exam has at least one valid score | Assessment Performance renders | The system displays score distribution using predefined score buckets | — |
| **AC9** | The selected exam has submission history | Assessment Over Time renders | The system displays submission trend per day using the configured metric | — |
| **AC10** | The class has enrolled learners | Progress & Reports loads | The system displays **Learner Completion Rate** based only on learning completion | — |
| **AC11** | The class has zero enrolled learners | Progress & Reports loads | Learner Completion Rate is displayed as **0%** | — |
| **AC12** | ILT/vILT sessions exist for the class | Progress & Reports loads | Attendance Rate is calculated using valid attendance records, excluding cancelled sessions | — |
| **AC13** | Attendance records or session schedules are updated | The user refreshes Progress & Reports | Attendance Rate reflects the latest data | — |
| **AC14** | Learner data exists in the class | Progress & Reports loads | The **Learner Detail Table** is displayed | — |
| **AC15** | Learner completion data exists | Learner Detail Table renders | **Learner Progress (%)** is displayed with correct calculation | — |
| **AC16** | Learner attendance data exists | Learner Detail Table renders | **Learner Attendance (%)** is displayed correctly | — |
| **AC17** | Admin/Instructor clicks a learner name | The system validates permission | The system navigates to **Learner Assessment Detail** scoped to the same class | — |
| **AC18** | Learner Assessment Detail page is loaded | The learner has assigned exams in this class | The system displays exam list, attempts, scores, and statuses | — |
| **AC19** | User is on Learner Assessment Detail page | The user navigates back | The system returns to Progress & Reports and preserves filter state | — |
> **Ticket id (for canonical folder):** `US-AD-095` → name the feature folder `US-AD-095-<FeatureName>`.
